name: Cheese Smothered Pork Chops
why: Verified from source card: 489 cal / 2g carbs / 35g protein per serving - dead-center of the 400-650 calorie band, far under the 35g carb ceiling, and 35g protein clears the high-protein identity easily. Structurally low-carb (pork + mayo + cheddar + onion, no starch base). Simple oven bake scales cleanly to 14 servings by weigh-and-divide. All ingredients map to the board (pork-chops, onions, mayonnaise, shredded-cheese/cheddar). Distinct from the run's creamy-cream-sauce pork chops: this is a mayo-and-cheddar bake, different technique and flavor, no cream/parmesan pan sauce.
